proof_body:
by
  intro N a
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (by simp) (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_finset_sum (fun i _ => by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)]
  have : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range N, ∫ x in a..(a + 2 * Real.pi), Real.cos (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x) = 0 := by
    intro k _
    have hk : ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left _ hk, integral_cos]
    have e : ((k : ℝ) + 1) * (a + 2 * Real.pi) = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * a + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [e, Real.sin_add_nat_mul_two_pi]
    simp
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero this]
  simp
target_source: ∀ (N : ℕ) (a : ℝ), ∫ x in a..(a + 2 * Real.pi), (1 + 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, Real.cos (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x)) = 2 * Real.pi
